headline: Recommended approval of signs for Crust & Foam at 507 Rantoul Street, The Granite Group at 97 River Street, and Harborlight House at 1 Monument Square.
summary: The Design Review Board reviewed and recommended approval of signage for three businesses: Crust & Foam at 507 Rantoul Street, The Granite Group at 97 River Street, and Harborlight House at 1 Monument Square. The board also approved the August 6, 2026 meeting minutes and added an agenda item on temporary signage for the next meeting.
decisions: Recommended approval of the signs for Crust & Foam at 507 Rantoul Street, 6-0 with Thornton absent.
Recommended approval of the wall sign for The Granite Group at 97 River Street, 6-0 with Thornton absent.
Recommended approval of the proposed signage for Harborlight House at 1 Monument Square, 6-0 with Thornton absent.
Approved the August 6, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended, 6-0 with Thornton absent.
Approved adding an agenda item on temporary signage and temporary banners for the next meeting, 6-0 with Thornton absent.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to recommend approval of the signs for Crust & Foam at 507 Rantoul Street, as discussed, with the wall sign in the sign band for the existing building and the logo as a projecting sign, 17”x17”. Scott seconds. Motion carries (6-0, Thornton absent).
Motion to recommend approval of the wall sign for The Granite Group at 97 River Street, as presented. Clawson seconds. Motion carries (6-0, Thornton absent).
Motion to recommend approval of the proposed signage for Harborlight House at 1 Monument Square, subject to the plans submitted. Flannery seconds. Motion carries (6-0, Thornton absent).
Motion to approve the August 6, 2026, meeting minutes, as amended. Scott seconds. Motion carried (6-0, Thornton absent).
Motion to include an agenda item regarding temporary signage and temporary banners at the next meeting. Scott seconds. Motion carried (6-0, Thornton absent).
